title: AnachroBench: Evaluating Historical Consistency in Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21292v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing Large Vision-Language Model benchmarks primarily evaluate visual understanding in general everyday scenarios, leaving historical consistency with a specified era and country largely underexplored. To address this gap, we propose AnachroBench, a controlled discriminative benchmark for evaluating historical consistency in visual scenes. It contains 1,600 image pairs from eight countries spanning the late 19th to the early 20th century, each pairing an original historical image with an anachronistic version containing a seamlessly inserted modern object. AnachroBench evaluates three aspects: Inserted Object Perception, which tests whether models detect the inserted modern object; Era-Country Consistency, which assesses whether the scene is consistent with the specified era and country; and Conditional Era-Country Consistency, which measures consistency judgments only when the inserted object is correctly perceived. translated_title: AnachroBench：评估大型视觉语言模型中的历史一致性
translated_abstract: 现有的大型视觉语言模型基准主要评估一般日常场景中的视觉理解能力，而模型与特定时代和国家的历史一致性在很大程度上尚未得到充分探索。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了AnachroBench，这是一个用于评估视觉场景历史一致性的受控判别式基准。它包含来自八个国家的1,600对图像，时间跨度为19世纪末至20世纪初，每对图像由一张原始历史图像与一个包含无缝插入现代物品的时代错置版本组成。AnachroBench从三个方面进行评估：插入物品感知，测试模型是否能检测出插入的现代物品；时代-国家一致性，评估场景是否与指定的时代和国家相符；条件时代-国家一致性，仅在插入物品被正确感知的情况下衡量一致性判断。错误的一致性判断……
tldr: 该论文提出AnachroBench基准，利用来自八个国家、跨越19世纪末至20世纪初的1,600对历史图像及其时代错置版本，从插入物品感知、时代-国家一致性和条件时代-国家一致性三个维度评估大型视觉语言模型的历史一致性能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes AnachroBench, a controlled discriminative benchmark consisting of 1,600 image pairs from eight countries spanning the late 19th to early 20th century, which evaluates Large Vision-Language Models' historical consistency through three dimensions: Inserted Object Perception, Era-Country Consistency, and Conditional Era-Country Consistency.
